summary.text: Alexander Jarvis is the Libertarian Party candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 104, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Jarvis described himself as a right-wing libertarian who follows a "live and let live" approach.
He said he would seek to remove as many taxes as he can, especially property and income taxes, reduce licensing and regulation, and reduce reliance on government welfare programs.
